versions.changelog: SEO：description 扩写（问题框架+中英双语+触发句）

Initial release of "book-to-skills" skill.

- Automatically extracts and analyzes electronic books (PDF, EPUB, TXT, MD) to generate multiple WorkBuddy skills.
- Supports three output modes: Knowledge Base, Action Guide, and Hybrid.
- Provides structured book analysis, suggest skill splits, and guides the user to select output type.
- Generates usable skill packages (knowledge and/or action skills), installs them locally, and creates an index document.
- Chinese and English books supported; includes customizable naming and trigger phrases.
